issues.sourceLocation: DyRAD v2 section 3.2, equation 2 and the immediately preceding Reflector Projection paragraph
issues.finding: The report writes the reflected-power factor as rho_i(d_i), but d_i is never defined and appears scalar. The paper defines rho_i(bold d_i), where bold d_i is the unit viewing direction from sensor to reflector. This matters because the term is aspect-dependent reflectivity, not a range-dependent scalar.
issues.recommendedFix: Use the source notation rho_i(\mathbf d_i) and define \mathbf d_i as the sensor-to-reflector unit viewing direction, or reuse the already defined line-of-sight unit vector consistently. Keep range r_i separate.
